title: Lee Collins's New Orleans band in Dallas, again
summary: He retells the Sherman Cook engagement when he played in the wrong key.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: See, Lee Collins also came to Dallas and New Orleans with a band. On guitar was Percy Darensbourg, Freddy Bobo on trumpet...on trombone, Lee Collins on trumpet and on the piano a man by the name of Rod Teague . After a few days he got home-sick so he went to (unintelligible), so Professor Sherman Cooke, who was a dancing man, and he came to my house and asked me if I could play several dates with him. This was that time when I (laughter) had to play in the wrong key.
